prompts.brew: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for Emberfell's medieval fantasy pixel RPG crafting UI. Create one 3 by 3 GRID of EXACTLY NINE frames, row-major reading order. Square 1536x1536 image, nine equal square 512x512 cells. Cell boundaries at x/y 512 and 1024. Each subject occupies the central 76% of its cell, all motion contained within the cell with at least 32px transparent padding. Each complete frame has identical camera, front three-quarter slightly elevated view, same apparent scale and same stationary base coordinates. Crisp detailed 16-bit pixel artwork, dark clean pixel outlines, textured metal/wood/stone, small controlled palette, warm parchment-compatible highlights. Logical source pixels about 128x128 per cell magnified with hard crisp edges, NO smooth painted gradients. Actual fully transparent background, no baked checkerboard, no border, no grid lines, no labels, no numbers, no letters, no watermark. All nine frames must depict successive moments of ONE coherent looping animation, not nine designs or angle variations. A round black iron cauldron with two side handles and three feet, filled with luminous green potion, resting above a tiny contained wood fire. A wooden spoon leans into the liquid and visibly stirs clockwise through nine sequential positions; liquid swirls, small bubbles rise and pop, fire flickers, a small steam wisp dissipates. No person or hands. Cauldron body, handles and feet are IDENTICAL and stationary in all cells. Only spoon, liquid, bubbles, flame and steam move. Frame 1 quiet leftward stirring; 2–4 spoon sweeps back and right; 5–7 sweeps forward and left; 8–9 return smoothly near frame 1.
